protocol.additional_target: Simultaneous rate RMS <= 5% and shape RMS <= 10%, sustained through the final incumbent.
paired_effects: PH minus NoMaSS shape error on Fisher data
Fisher minus uniform shape error for each method
protocol.uncertainty: Within-case exact sign tests and exact 95% intervals for the probability of improvement; Holm correction across the six cases within each comparison family. No iid intervals pooled across physical regimes.
protocol.timing: Cold, warm, and CPU paired ratios on shared sustained successes; all misses retained in attainment curves; original and added cohorts reported separately.
protocol.exceptions: Broad cyclic PH design median is fixed because its ten PH datasets are reused. Recheck NoMaSS design benefit there and PH versus NoMaSS on the narrow cycle.

statistical_notes: Negative paired differences favor the first named strategy. Exact two-sided sign tests exclude ties within 1e-12. Intervals concern probability of improvement among non-ties, not median effect. Intervals are nominal within-case 95%; p-values are Holm-adjusted across six physical cases separately for each comparison family and cohort. All-ten is the union of the two subsets, not an independent replication. Heterogeneous-case pooled counts have no iid inferential interval.
timing_notes: The original 36 NoMaSS fits and all PH/design timings are retained unchanged. The additional 84 NoMaSS fits are newly timed. Cohort-specific wall and CPU ratios expose session differences. Ratios condition on shared sustained successes; curves retain every miss.
